title: Nuevas industrias
goal: Read how governments moved from protecting private industry to building state-owned steel and utility companies that supplied cheap inputs to manufacturers across the region.
grammar: Por parte de: atribuir la acción en construcciones formales

items: State which steel company Brazil's government inaugurated.
Explain the new economic role many governments took on.
Name the heavy industrial goods that had to be manufactured once easy consumer-goods substitution reached its limit.
Describe the industrial sectors that countries like Brazil had thanks to sustained government support.
Use por parte de to attribute an action to an agent in formal writing.
